source: Aggregated from the public-procurement register (АОП/ЦАИС ЕОП) across the 25 МО-group awarder EIKs as of the 2026-07-09 build, all years — contracts whose subject matches an aircraft platform, aero-engine, helicopter or aviation fuel. Spend, not a verdict.
note: Provenance is the roster AS BUILT, not the current one: MO_ENTITIES has since grown to 27 (РВИМ Плевен, НПМ Шипка-Бузлуджа), neither of which has an aviation contract, so no figure below moves — but a future addition that does would make these numbers a subset of what the line claims. The visible cost of keeping the Soviet-era and legacy fleet flying — the sustainment that DOES run through ЗОП, unlike the F-16 acquisition (US FMS).
